V4 DISCOVERY GROUNDING

Before idea generation:
1. Ground the topic in 30-50 relevant papers when retrieval permits.
2. Build a novelty tree: Type 1 new task/problem; Type 2 new paradigm/pipeline/representation; Type 3 new mechanism/module; Type 4 incremental modification.
3. Build a challenge -> insight map.
4. For every detected GAP-ID, run the well-established-solution check:
   Level 1: same task already solved well -> SWITCH.
   Level 2: same technical core solved across domains -> SWITCH.
   Level 3: only limited/distant-domain solutions -> PROCEED.
   Level 4: no known good solution -> PROCEED.
5. Use quote-or-zero evidence: every solution-level claim must point to an exact supplied paper title and an exact short quote from the supplied abstract. Unsupported claims receive LOW confidence.
6. If the grounded pool is below the configured minimum, fail closed unless the user explicitly relaxes the setting.
